apr-1782415237300-szn6.issueSummary: Filter option should have categories listed to select

testCases.name: [TC-004] Deselecting a Category Restores the Broader Result Set
testCases.precondition: User has already selected one or more categories in the filter

steps.description: With "Bags" selected, note the filtered product count

steps.expectedResult: "Bags" is no longer marked as selected
Results expand back to the state before "Bags" was selected

steps.description: If all categories are now deselected, verify the full catalogue is shown

testCases.outcome: Deselecting a category immediately removes that filter and updates the product listing accordingly. ---
testCases.content:
## Test Case: [TC-004] Deselecting a Category Restores the Broader Result Set

**Type:** Functional
**Priority:** High

### Preconditions
- User has already selected one or more categories in the filter

### Test Steps
| Step | Action | Expected Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | With "Bags" selected, note the filtered product count | Baseline filtered count recorded |
| 2 | Click "Bags" again to deselect it | "Bags" is no longer marked as selected |
| 3 | Observe the product listing | Results expand back to the state before "Bags" was selected |
| 4 | If all categories are now deselected, verify the full catalogue is shown | Unfiltered listing is restored |

### Expected Outcome
Deselecting a category immediately removes that filter and updates the product listing accordingly.

---

testCases.name: [TC-005] Selecting a Category With Zero Products Shows an Empty State
testCases.precondition:
A category exists in the filter list that currently has no associated products (e.g. due to stock or seasonal unavailability)
OR the tester can simulate this by combining mutually exclusive filter criteria

steps.description: Select a category known to have no available products
Verify an empty-state message is displayed
steps.expectedResult: A user-friendly message appears (e.g. "No products found in this category")

steps.description: Verify no error or broken layout occurs
steps.expectedResult: Page remains stable; no JS errors in console

testCases.outcome: When a selected category returns no results, a clear empty-state message is displayed and the page remains stable. ---
testCases.content:
## Test Case: [TC-005] Selecting a Category With Zero Products Shows an Empty State

**Type:** Negative
**Priority:** High

### Preconditions
- A category exists in the filter list that currently has no associated products (e.g. due to stock or seasonal unavailability)
- OR the tester can simulate this by combining mutually exclusive filter criteria

### Test Steps
| Step | Action | Expected Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | Select a category known to have no available products | Category is marked as selected |
| 2 | Observe the product listing area | No product cards are rendered |
| 3 | Verify an empty-state message is displayed | A user-friendly message appears (e.g. "No products found in this category") |
| 4 | Verify no error or broken layout occurs | Page remains stable; no JS errors in console |
| 5 | Deselect the category | Products from other categories return |

### Expected Outcome
When a selected category returns no results, a clear empty-state message is displayed and the page remains stable.

---

testCases.name: [TC-006] Category Options Display a Product Count Badge
testCases.precondition: User is on a listing page with the category filter visible

steps.description: Open the filter panel and inspect the category list
steps.expectedResult: Each category label shows a numeric count alongside it (e.g. "Bags (42)")

steps.description: Select an additional filter (e.g. a brand filter) that reduces the available product set
steps.expectedResult: Category counts update to reflect the narrowed product set

steps.description: Verify the count next to a category matches the number of results that would be returned if that category were selected
steps.expectedResult: Count is accurate and dynamically updated
Category counts revert to their original values

testCases.outcome: Each category in the filter list shows an accurate, dynamically updated product count to guide user selection. ---
testCases.content:
## Test Case: [TC-006] Category Options Display a Product Count Badge

**Type:** Functional
**Priority:** High

### Preconditions
- User is on a listing page with the category filter visible

### Test Steps
| Step | Action | Expected Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | Open the filter panel and inspect the category list | Each category label shows a numeric count alongside it (e.g. "Bags (42)") |
| 2 | Select an additional filter (e.g. a brand filter) that reduces the available product set | Category counts update to reflect the narrowed product set |
| 3 | Verify the count next to a category matches the number of results that would be returned if that category were selected | Count is accurate and dynamically updated |
| 4 | Deselect the additional filter | Category counts revert to their original values |

### Expected Outcome
Each category in the filter list shows an accurate, dynamically updated product count to guide user selection.

---

testCases.name: [TC-010] Category List Loads Correctly When API Response Is Slow (Loading State)
testCases.precondition:
Browser DevTools Network throttling set to "Slow 3G" (or equivalent ≥ 2 s latency)
PLP is loaded fresh

steps.description: Navigate to PLP under throttled conditions

steps.expectedResult: A loading skeleton, spinner, or placeholder is shown in the Category section

steps.description: Wait for the network response to complete
steps.expectedResult: Category list replaces the loading state with actual options

steps.description: Verify no categories are duplicated in the list

testCases.outcome: The filter panel gracefully handles delayed API responses with a visible loading state, then renders the correct category list without duplicates when data arrives. ---
testCases.content:
## Test Case: [TC-010] Category List Loads Correctly When API Response Is Slow (Loading State)

**Type:** Functional
**Priority:** High

### Preconditions
- Browser DevTools Network throttling set to "Slow 3G" (or equivalent ≥ 2 s latency)
- PLP is loaded fresh

### Test Steps
| Step | Action | Expected Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | Navigate to PLP under throttled conditions | Page begins loading |
| 2 | Immediately open/inspect the Filter panel | A loading skeleton, spinner, or placeholder is shown in the Category section |
| 3 | Wait for the network response to complete | Category list replaces the loading state with actual options |
| 4 | Verify no categories are duplicated in the list | Each category appears exactly once |
| 5 | Select a category | Filter behaves normally post-load |

### Expected Outcome
The filter panel gracefully handles delayed API responses with a visible loading state, then renders the correct category list without duplicates when data arrives.

---
